logic.entry: Buy at the same OOS start executable minute open irrespective of signal.
logic.exit: Hold to common OOS terminal execution and liquidate with the same costs.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT unlevered long-only spot benchmark.

sources.citation: Shen, D., Urquhart, A., & Wang, P. (2022). Bitcoin intraday time-series momentum. Financial Review, 57(2), 319–344. DOI:10.1111/fire.12290.
sources.reported_finding: The authors report that the first half-hour positively predicts the last half-hour return and that high-volume/high-volatility first sessions show stronger predictability. This BTC study motivates, but does not validate, our fixed UTC-hour BTC/ETH spot adaptation.
